**Observation Log:**

[FACT] The user has been using Nike Dri-FIT running socks for about 6 months.  
[FACT] The user has been using Asics Gel-Kayano shoes for about 1 month.  
[EVENT] The user is looking for advice on how to properly wash their Nike Dri-FIT running socks to get rid of the smell.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a step-by-step guide on how to wash the Nike Dri-FIT socks effectively, including checking the care label, turning them inside out, washing in cold water, using mild detergent, and avoiding over-washing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended adding 1/2 cup of white vinegar to the wash cycle or soaking the socks in a vinegar solution (1 part vinegar to 2 parts water) for about an hour before washing to remove odor-causing bacteria.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested air drying or tumble drying on low heat to prevent shrinkage and advised against wringing or twisting the socks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided additional tips, including washing socks regularly every 3-5 wearings, storing them properly, and considering using an odor-controlling spray.
